author: Nostalgia Nerd
description:
Thank you to sponsor Hypershell! https://hypershell.tech/a/omnitrack/34d9c712 ~ We went to The National Museum of Computing at Bletchley Park to look at incredible machines such as The Bombe, Tunny, Colossus, EDSAC, Marconi TAC, ICL 2996, Hollerith HEC and The Witch. These machines are crucial to the birth and modernisation of computers, and this museum is a must see.

Thank you to @tnmoc for allowing us access and to Robert for educating us on these pieces of computing history.
